newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Oregon Metallurgical started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Oregon Metallurgical started.

text.p: -- Dain Bosworth Inc said Tuesday it initiated coverage of Oregon Metallurgical Corp with a buy rating and earnings estimates of $2.09 a share in 1997 and $2.69 in 1998.

-- Fears of a shrinking golf clubhead market and increased competition from Russian suppliers appear to be the reasons behind a 40-percent decline in Oregon Metallurgical's stock price since December 3 to 22-3/4, Dain Bosworth said.
-- Golf market titanium sales are expected to fall to 4.5 million pounds in 1997 because manufacturers stockpiled titanium in anticipation of future price increases, Dain Bosworth said.
-- Oregon Metallurgical is one of only two domestic makers of the pure form of titanium used to produce all other titanium products for the leisure and aerospace markets.
-- Its shares closed up 1/2 Tuesday at 22-1/2.
